```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

sumstats <- read_csv("kegg_sumstats.csv")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}

ggplot(data=sumstats, mapping = aes(x = Edges, y = Nodes)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha=0.5) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  geom_point(
      data = filter(sumstats, Edges == 149),
      shape = 1,
      size = 7, 
      color = "#720F32",
      stroke = 1.5 
      ) +
  labs(title="Log-log plot of Edge vs. Node Counts per KEGG Metabolic Pathway", x="Number of Edges", y="Number of Nodes")

```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
